For you: the script is running in the background as bash_1 (pid 2187611). The first line so far is "slow job started: pid 2187611 at Wed Nov 4 05:21:56 AM KST 2026". I'm waiting on a completion monitor and will report the final line once it exits.

Next: read the final output and report it.
